why:
In the vendored eidolon (bab3813) a run never sits in its caller's journal:
- The only way to start a run is the CLI `eidolon workflow run`, and it always makes a NEW session. eidolon/crates/cli/src/workflow.rs:1-4 says 'A run is a session (ruling 8): the door creates one'; its one call site is cli/src/main.rs:576.
- A run inside the caller's session is described, but 'what the model is told about a run … is still open' (eidolon/crates/core/src/session/mod.rs:564-575).
- The door's replay drops workflow records (eidolon/crates/web/src/wire.rs:497 `_ => {}`).
With C, an agent's runs go through the perch and need nothing from this slice. A run started outside the perch is what is left: the CLI by hand, or an agent's bash where slice GW does not refuse it. It lands in a session of its own in eidolon's sessions dir (the 'other' list). Opened as a saved chat, its workflow records become W1's rows (core/saved.js:145-161), not a graph. This slice draws that session as a graph, read-only, because no route could answer, cancel or abandon a run the perch did not start.
what:
graph/chatrun.js (new: pure functions first, then one component), wired into GP-a's strip and GP-b's pane. Line numbers are master 08c01fa; W2b-2 merged at b761462.

The inspected chat IS a run session:
- `runOfSession(s)` reads s.calls.value and s.finished.value (core/state.js:719, 744), so it redraws when calls arrive.
  - It finds the calls with origin 'script' (state.js:713; saved.js:156) whose id matches /^w(\d+)-/, and returns { run }.
  - It returns null when there is no such call, or when the script calls carry two different run numbers. A run session holds exactly one run (`run` always makes a session, cli/src/workflow.rs; F0 README 'Record shapes'), so two numbers mean something this slice does not draw. That shape would come from a future in-session run (session/mod.rs:564-575), and nothing here cuts one run out of another.
- The strip entry's key is `w:<sid>:<run>` (GP-a's reserved shape). It fails ridOk, so no runs/ path is ever built.
  - Its label is 'run w<run>' until the journal is read, then '<plugin> <workflow>' from WorkflowStart, through clean.
  - Under a door there is no entry: nothing can read the journal.

Reading:
- One GET of `sessions/${encodeURIComponent(sid)}/log` (perch/src/serve.rs:890-899: `eidolon log --json` lines; 404 for an unknown id; 413, 504 and 502 have their own sentences).
  - hubText(path, 16000) (core/api.js:140) when a person picks the sub-tab or a pane opens on it.
  - hubPollText(path, 16000) (core/lane.js:48) for a re-read. The 16 s is runs.js's (runs.js:352): the perch gives `eidolon log` 15 s (titles.rs:41), and the lane's default of 10 s (lane.js:19, 47-48) would fail a large log on the client every time while holding the page's one lane slot (lane.js:1-3).
- Re-read only a view that is on screen (the tab's body or an open pane), and only when core/hub.js `list` arrives (polled every 5 s, hub.js:16-33). Never on a timer of its own: each read is the whole log and one eidolon process (no ?after= on this route, serve.rs:790-792).
- Each view keeps `at`, the mtime its row had when its last read was asked, and `confirmed`. On each hub list, with the view's row in it:
  - the view has ended: nothing. Ended means a status other than running or parked. A parked view is NOT ended: `eidolon workflow resume` appends to the same journal (F0 b: 30, then 57 records);
  - the row's mtime differs from `at`: one re-read; `at` becomes that mtime and `confirmed` false;
  - the same mtime and not `confirmed`: ONE confirming re-read, then `confirmed` is true;
  - else nothing.
- Why the confirming read: the mtime is whole seconds (titles.rs:233-236 mtime_secs; sessions.rs:812, 815). A write in the same second as a read, after it, leaves the mtime as it was, and for an ending run that last write is the WorkflowEnd. The confirming read catches it, because it is asked at least one hub poll (5 s) after the poll that first showed that mtime, so after every write of that second. At most two reads per distinct mtime, and none once the run has ended.
- Reduce with jevrun.js unchanged, the way runs.js does: newRun({ graph: doc }) then feedText() with the whole log. take() skips ids it already holds, so a re-read adds only what is new (jevrun.js:298-327).
  - doc is graphDoc(<workflow>) when the perch offers that graph (runs.js:222-230), else the journal's own jev_graph pages (jevrun.js:414-432).
  - One reducer per key, in a map capped at 8. It is separate from runs.js's loop table: these runs are never polled.

The view: ChatRunView({ key, v, sentence }) is drawn in the tab and the pane in place of RunView. It is not RunView, because it has no perch row (RunView, view.js:236).
- A header: '<plugin> <workflow>' and argsText(args) (view.js:84-87).
- drawGraph (view.js:248), pathText, budgetParts and spendLine (view.js:141-164). Its no-drawing line is GP-a's cleaned `clean(g.error, 240)` (view.js:249), never the raw tool text.
- A status line from v alone:
  - done or arrived;
  - 'the graph ended in its failed state';
  - 'exhausted';
  - parked: 'parked: it waits for an answer where it was started (eidolon workflow resume)';
  - no WorkflowEnd: 'no end in its journal: still going or cut off' (a SIGKILL leaves none: F0 k's first invocation, its first 24 records).
- Then `<${Steps} rid=${key} v=${v} row=${null} readonly=${true} />`.
- It NEVER shows [ cancel ], [ abandon ], [ answer ] or [ stop ]: no route could do them.

Read-only through W2b-2's steps.js (merged). `readonly` is threaded Steps -> Frame and stops there:
- `export function Steps({ rid, v, row })` (steps.js:177) becomes `Steps({ rid, v, row, readonly })`;
- its Frame call (steps.js:187) passes `readonly=${readonly}`;
- `function Frame({ rid, s, v, row })` (steps.js:145) takes readonly;
- ParkAsk's `live=${...}` (steps.js:169-170) becomes `live=${!readonly && !!(v.waiting && v.waiting.park && v.waiting.park.call_id === p.call_id)}`.
park.js is NOT edited: ParkAsk's `!live` branch (park.js:52-59) already draws a park read-only, with no K, its question and 'not answered' or the answered line.
- RunView's `<${Steps} rid=${rid} v=${v} row=${row} />` (view.js:259) stays as it is (steps.test.mjs:398 pins it). An undefined readonly is false, so the perch runs' views do not change.
- The signature pin, steps.test.mjs:397 `/export function Steps\(\{ rid, v, row \}\)/`, becomes `/export function Steps\(\{ rid, v, row, readonly \}\)/` (granted in owns_files).

Pane (GP-b's pane.js): a chat-run key draws ChatRunView, with the same reading rules.

Docs:
- graph/README.md: rows for chatrun.js and for the readonly prop. It says that a run started through the perch (RA and PR) is a perch run and not this view's, and that a run started outside the perch shows only when its own session is opened.
- tests/README.md: a chatrun.test.mjs row.
